title: Web Portal Application
summary: Full-stack web portal with HTTP routes, navigation menus, feedback forms, input validation, and persistent JSON storage.

configuration.title: Portal Title
configuration.description: Brand title for portal header and pages

configuration.title: HTTP Port
configuration.description: Local TCP port for web server

steps.description: Establish HTTP endpoints for portal pages, submission forms, and JSON API
Store validated feedback and form submissions in persistent JSON storage

explanations.beginner: This application creates a web website with multiple pages, a navigation bar, and an online submission form. Messages sent through the form are checked for valid email addresses and saved to a file.
explanations.intermediate: The recipe combines Otter's native HTTP routing and static file serving with `otter-official/file-helpers` for saving form submissions and `otter-official/text-utils` for string formatting.
explanations.advanced: Implements RESTful HTTP routes on Kestrel/HttpListener. Static assets are served from the `public` directory while API routes validate payloads and persist records into JSON storage.
